# Setup and Load Data

```{r setup}
#| cache: false
# Load required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(TermineR)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(limma)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)  # Change based on organism
  library(here)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
})

# Set options and directories
options(max.print = 1000, scipen = 999, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
source(here("scr/helper_functions.R"))
config <- load_stage_parameters(
  stage = "inferential",
  config_path = default_pipeline_config_path()
)
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

```

# Differential Abundance Analysis (simplified)

```{r differential_analysis}
#| cache: true

# Simple function to run DA on one dataset
run_limma_analysis <- function(se, dataset_name, annotation_df = NULL) {
  
  message("Running DA on '", dataset_name, "' with ", nrow(se), " features...")
  
  # Filter annotation to match SE rows (when provided)
  if (!is.null(annotation_df)) {
    annotation_df <- annotation_df %>% 
      filter(nterm_modif_peptide %in% rownames(se))
  }
  
  # Get data matrix
  data_matrix <- assay(se)
  design_data <- normalize_pipeline_experimental_design(as.data.frame(colData(se)))
  
  # Get conditions and check they exist
  conditions <- design_data$condition

  available_conditions <- unique(conditions)
  message("Available conditions: ", paste(available_conditions, collapse = ", "))
  
  # Create design matrix
  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + condition, data = design_data)
  colnames(design) <- str_remove(colnames(design), "^condition")
  message("Design matrix columns: ", paste(colnames(design), collapse = ", "))
  
  # Check which contrasts we can actually make
  valid_contrasts <- list()
  for (contrast_name in names(defined_contrasts)) {
    contrast_formula <- defined_contrasts[[contrast_name]]
    
    # Extract condition names from contrast formula
    contrast_conditions <- str_extract_all(contrast_formula, "[A-Za-z_0-9]+")[[1]]
    contrast_conditions <- contrast_conditions[contrast_conditions %in% available_conditions]
    
    if (length(contrast_conditions) >= 2) {

      valid_contrasts[[contrast_name]] <- contrast_formula
      message("✓ Valid contrast: ", contrast_name, " = ", contrast_formula)

    } else {

      message("✗ Skipping contrast (missing conditions): ", contrast_name)
      
    }
  }
  
  if (length(valid_contrasts) == 0) {
    stop("No valid contrasts found for dataset: ", dataset_name)
  }
  
  # Create contrast matrix for valid contrasts only (use indices to avoid name mismatches)
  contrast_vec <- unname(unlist(valid_contrasts))

  alias_names <- names(valid_contrasts)

  contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_vec, levels = design)

  message("Contrast matrix columns: ", paste(colnames(contrast_matrix), collapse = ", "))

  if (isTRUE(use_blocking)) {
    blocking_values <- resolve_limma_blocking_values(
      experimental_design = design_data,
      blocking_column = blocking_column,
      dataset_name = dataset_name
    )

    message("Blocking enabled using column '", blocking_column, "'. (Repeated measures experiment)")

    cor <- duplicateCorrelation(
      data_matrix,
      design,
      block = blocking_values
    )

    fit <- lmFit(
      data_matrix,
      design,
      method = "ls",
      block = blocking_values,
      correlation = cor$consensus
    )
  } else {
    message("Blocking disabled. Running limma without duplicateCorrelation().")

    fit <- lmFit(
      data_matrix,
      design,
      method = "robust"
    )
  }

  fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
  
  # Extract results for each contrast (by index, mapped to alias names)
  results_list <- vector("list", length(alias_names))

  names(results_list) <- alias_names

  for (i in seq_along(alias_names)) {
    contrast_name <- alias_names[i]
    
    result <- topTable(fit2, coef = i, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH") %>%
      rownames_to_column("nterm_modif_peptide")
    
    if (!is.null(annotation_df)) {
      result <- result %>% left_join(annotation_df, by = "nterm_modif_peptide")
    } else {
      result <- result %>%
        mutate(
          protein = nterm_modif_peptide
        ) %>% 
        mutate(
          nterm_modif_peptide = NA_character_
        )
    }

    result <- result %>%
      mutate(
        contrast = contrast_name,
        dataset = dataset_name,
        regulation = case_when(
          adj.P.Val < pval_threshold & logFC > log2(fc_threshold) ~ "upregulated",
          adj.P.Val < pval_threshold & logFC < -log2(fc_threshold) ~ "downregulated",
          TRUE ~ "not_significant"
        )
      )
    
    results_list[[contrast_name]] <- result
  }
  
  # Combine all results
  all_results <- bind_rows(results_list)
  
  return(list(
    results = all_results,
    individual_contrasts = results_list,
    se_used = se,
    dataset = dataset_name
  ))
}

# Run analysis on each dataset
limma_results_list <- list()

for (ds in names(se_map)) {
  
  se <- se_map[[ds]]
  annotation_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(se))
  
  # Protein-level analysis uses all features (skip scope filtering)
  if (ds == "protein_abund_norm") {

    se_subset <- se
    annotation_df <- NULL
    
  } else {
    # Filter to features in scope for DA
    features_in_scope <- annotation_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        is_in_scope_for_interest == TRUE
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(nterm_modif_peptide) %>%
      intersect(rownames(se))
    
    if (length(features_in_scope) == 0) {

      message("No features in scope for '", ds, "'. Trying semi-specific only...")

      features_in_scope <- annotation_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(specificity %in% interesting_specificity) %>%
        dplyr::pull(nterm_modif_peptide) %>%
        intersect(rownames(se))
      
      if (length(features_in_scope) == 0) {
        message("Still no features found. Skipping dataset: ", ds)
        next
      }
    }
    
    # Subset to features in scope
    se_subset <- se[features_in_scope, ]
  }
  
  # Run analysis
  limma_results_list[[ds]] <- run_limma_analysis(se_subset, ds, annotation_df)
}

# Combine all results
if (length(limma_results_list) > 0) {

  all_results_combined <- map_dfr(limma_results_list, ~.x$results)
  
  message("✓ Differential analysis completed successfully!")
  message("Total results: ", nrow(all_results_combined), " rows across ", length(limma_results_list), " datasets")
  
} else {

  stop("No datasets could be analyzed")

}
```

```{r save_limma_results}
    dplyr::select(
```

```{r go_helpers}
#| cache: false
# Utilities for GO enrichment and plotting across BP/MF/CC with simplification

run_go_enrichment <- function(upregulated_features,
                              universe,
                              OrgDb,
                              keyType = "UNIPROT",
                              ont = c("BP", "MF", "CC")) {
  results <- list()
  for (o in ont) {
    
    cc <- tryCatch({
      clusterProfiler::compareCluster(
        protein ~ regulation + contrast,
        data = upregulated_features,
        fun = "enrichGO",
        OrgDb = OrgDb,
        keyType = keyType,
        ont = o,
        pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        universe = universe,
        qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
        minGSSize = 10,
        maxGSSize = 500,
        readable = TRUE
      )
    }, error = function(e) NULL)

    if (!is.null(cc)) {
      cc_simpl <- tryCatch({
        clusterProfiler::simplify(cc)
      }, error = function(e) cc)

      results[[o]] <- cc_simpl

    } else {

      results[[o]] <- NULL

    }
  }
  results
}

plot_go_compare <- function(go_cc, main_title = "GO") {
  if (is.null(go_cc) || nrow(go_cc) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  go_df <- as.data.frame(go_cc)

  # Derive change_direction and comparison_name
  if (!all(c("regulation", "contrast") %in% names(go_df))) {
    go_df <- go_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        change_direction = dplyr::case_when(
          stringr::str_detect(Cluster, "upregulated") ~ "upregulated",
          stringr::str_detect(Cluster, "downregulated") ~ "downregulated",
          stringr::str_detect(Cluster, "not_significant") ~ "not_significant",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        comparison_name = dplyr::case_when(
          !is.na(change_direction) ~ stringr::str_trim(
            stringr::str_remove(Cluster, ".*(upregulated|downregulated|not_significant)[[:punct:]]?\
*")),
          TRUE ~ Cluster
        )
      )
  } else {
    go_df <- go_df %>% dplyr::rename(change_direction = regulation, comparison_name = contrast)
  }

  go_df_plot <- go_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(change_direction), !is.na(comparison_name)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(comparison_name, change_direction) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(order_by = p.adjust, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    go_df_plot,
    ggplot2::aes(x = change_direction, y = Description, size = Count, color = p.adjust)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point() +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(~ comparison_name) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(main_title) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_continuous(name = "p.adjust", trans = "reverse") +
    ggplot2::scale_size(name = "Count") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.1, size = 8),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8)
    )
}

  flatten_go_results <- function(go_results) {
    purrr::imap_dfr(go_results, function(go_list, dataset_name) {
      purrr::imap_dfr(go_list, function(go_result, ontology_name) {
        if (is.null(go_result)) {
          return(tibble::tibble())
        }

        go_df <- as.data.frame(go_result)

        if (nrow(go_df) == 0) {
          return(tibble::tibble())
        }

        go_df %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            dataset = dataset_name,
            ontology = ontology_name,
            .before = 1
          )
      })
    })
  }
```

```{r go_enrichment}
#| cache: false
#| fig-width: !expr plot_width
#| fig-height: !expr plot_height

  if (!should_run_go_analysis) {
    message("Skipping GO enrichment because stages.inferential.run_go_analysis is FALSE.")
  } else {
    go_results_path <- file.path(rds_dir, paste0(pre_fix, "_go_enrichment_results.rds"))
    go_results_tsv_path <- file.path(results_dir, paste0(pre_fix, "_go_enrichment_results.tsv"))

    go_limma_results <- if (exists("limma_results")) {
      limma_results
    } else {
      read_rds(limma_results_path)
    }

    go_limma_results_list <- go_limma_results$by_dataset

    if (!file.exists(go_results_path)) {
      message("No pre-search GO enrichment results found. Running GO enrichment...")

      go_results <- list()

      for (ds in names(go_limma_results_list)) {
        message("Running GO enrichment for dataset: ", ds)

        differential_abundant_features <- go_limma_results_list[[ds]]$results %>%
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(protein)) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            regulation = dplyr::case_when(
              adj.P.Val < pval_threshold & logFC > log2(fc_threshold) ~ "upregulated",
              adj.P.Val < pval_threshold & logFC < -log2(fc_threshold) ~ "downregulated",
              TRUE ~ "not_significant"
            )
          ) %>%
          dplyr::filter(regulation != "not_significant") %>%
          dplyr::select(protein, regulation, contrast) %>%
          dplyr::distinct()

        if (nrow(differential_abundant_features) == 0) {
          message("No significant features for ", ds)
          next
        }

        universe_genes <- go_limma_results_list[[ds]]$results %>%
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(protein)) %>%
          dplyr::pull(protein) %>%
          unique()

        go_list <- run_go_enrichment(
          upregulated_features = differential_abundant_features,
          universe = universe_genes,
          OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
          keyType = "UNIPROT",
          ont = c("BP", "MF", "CC")
        )

        go_results[[ds]] <- go_list

        for (o in c("BP", "MF", "CC")) {
          p <- plot_go_compare(go_list[[o]], main_title = paste0("GO ", o, " - ", ds))
          if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
        }
      }

      if (length(go_results) > 0) {
        write_rds(go_results, go_results_path)
      }
    } else {
      message("Loading pre-computed GO enrichment results... (corroborate these were run on the same limma results!)")
      go_results <- read_rds(go_results_path)
    }

    go_results_table <- flatten_go_results(go_results)

    if (nrow(go_results_table) > 0) {
      write_tsv(go_results_table, go_results_tsv_path)
    } else {
      message("No GO enrichment rows to export.")
    }
  }
```

# GroupGO CC on features from limma results

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| fig-width: !expr plot_width
#| fig-height: !expr plot_height

  if (!should_run_go_analysis) {
    message("Skipping GroupGO mapping because stages.inferential.run_go_analysis is FALSE.")
  } else {
    go_groups_path <- file.path(rds_dir, paste0(pre_fix, "_go_cc_mapping.rds"))
    go_groups_tsv_path <- file.path(results_dir, paste0(pre_fix, "_go_cc_grouping_results.tsv"))
    go_mapping_tsv_path <- file.path(results_dir, paste0(pre_fix, "_go_cc_mapping.tsv"))

    go_limma_results <- if (exists("limma_results")) {
      limma_results
    } else {
      read_rds(limma_results_path)
    }

    go_limma_results_list <- go_limma_results$by_dataset

    if (!file.exists(go_groups_path)) {
      message("No pre-computed GO CC mapping found. Running GroupGO...")

      groupgo_results <- list()

      for (ds in names(go_limma_results_list)) {
        message("Running GroupGO for dataset: ", ds)

        all_genes <- go_limma_results_list[[ds]]$results %>%
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(protein)) %>%
          dplyr::pull(protein) %>%
          unique()

        if (length(all_genes) == 0) {
          message("No genes found for ", ds)
          next
        }

        groupgo_cc <- tryCatch({
          clusterProfiler::groupGO(
            gene = all_genes,
            OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
            keyType = "UNIPROT",
            ont = "CC",
            level = 3,
            readable = TRUE
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)

        if (is.null(groupgo_cc) || nrow(as.data.frame(groupgo_cc)) == 0) {
          message("No GroupGO results for ", ds)
          next
        }

        groupgo_results[[ds]] <- groupgo_cc
      }

      if (length(groupgo_results) > 0) {
        write_rds(groupgo_results, go_groups_path)
      }
    } else {
      message("Loading pre-computed GO CC mapping... (corroborate these were run on the same limma results!)")
      groupgo_results <- read_rds(go_groups_path)
    }

    groupgo_results_table <- purrr::imap_dfr(groupgo_results, function(groupgo_result, dataset_name) {
      if (is.null(groupgo_result)) {
        return(tibble::tibble())
      }

      groupgo_df <- as.data.frame(groupgo_result)

      if (nrow(groupgo_df) == 0) {
        return(tibble::tibble())
      }

      groupgo_df %>%
        dplyr::mutate(dataset = dataset_name, .before = 1)
    })

    if (nrow(groupgo_results_table) > 0) {
      write_tsv(groupgo_results_table, go_groups_tsv_path)

      go_cc_mapping <- groupgo_results_table %>%
        distinct() %>%
        dplyr::filter(Count >= 2) %>%
        separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
        dplyr::select(gene = geneID, GO = ID, Description) %>%
        group_by(gene) %>%
        summarise(
          GO = paste(unique(GO), collapse = "; "),
          Description = paste(unique(Description), collapse = "; "),
          n_GO_terms = n(),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          extracellular_or_cytoplasm = case_when(
            str_detect(Description, "extracellular") ~ "extracellular",
            str_detect(Description, "cytoplasm|intracellular") ~ "cytoplasm",
            str_detect(Description, "membrane") ~ "membrane",
            TRUE ~ "other/various"
          )
        )

      write_tsv(go_cc_mapping, go_mapping_tsv_path)
    } else {
      message("No GroupGO rows to export.")
    }
  }
```
